order_wins: **Enviro Infra Engineers** — step-down subsidiary **Suyog Urja** takes the EPC turnkey works for the **180 MW NTPC wind project at Parli, Maharashtra from Tata Power Renewable Energy, Rs 189.99 crore excluding GST** _(~5.5% of mcap)_, for execution by 31 March 2027.

**Organic Recycling Systems** — wholly owned **Solapur Bioenergy** secures two **BPCL** EPCOM contracts for municipal-waste compressed bio-gas plants, **Mysuru at Rs 85.56 crore** _(~32.4% of mcap)_ and **Raipur at Rs 81.73 crore**, both including GST, each 15 months plus five years of O&M.

**Deep Industries** — receives an **ONGC Letter of Award for gas-compression services at Balol GGS-1, Mehsana, for three years, estimated at about Rs 88.15 crore** _(~1.8% of mcap)_, which the filing states is in the ordinary course of business.

**HLE Glascoat** — step-down subsidiary HLE Surface Technologies GmbH wins a **EUR 20.56 million contract from FLC Portals Group I/S, Denmark** for vitreous enamel cladding panels for the Fehmarn–Lolland tunnel, to April 2030. No rupee equivalent is stated.

**Goldiam International** — the company and its wholly owned subsidiaries receive **export purchase orders aggregating Rs 60 crore from USA clients** for lab-grown diamond jewellery _(~1.2% of mcap)_, for fulfilment by 31 December 2026, excluding its online orders.

**Hazoor Multi Projects** — takes an **NHAI Letter of Award dated 7 September for user-fee collection at the H. Pudhupatti plaza on NH-179A, Tamil Nadu, Rs 41.98 crore for one year** _(~7.3% of mcap)_, with upkeep of the adjacent toilet blocks.

**Ceigall India** — emerges **H-1 bidder for Nawada District stone-block Lot 4 from the Government of Bihar at Rs 28.82 crore a year, rising 20% annually, Rs 214.52 crore cumulative over five years excluding GST**. No contract has yet been awarded.

**RMC Switchgears** — receives **MAHAVITRAN letters of award worth Rs 14,98,65,900 for off-grid DC solar water-pumping systems under PM-KUSUM B** _(~6.1% of mcap)_, over five years; the filing describes them as empanelment, rate contract and quantity allocation.

**Affordable Robotic & Automation** — receives a **turnkey purchase order for a robotic welding line of approximately Rs 13,66,33,424** _(~7.2% of mcap)_, for delivery by December 2026. The customer is "not disclosed due to confidentiality".

**HCL Technologies** — launches an **Advanced Semiconductor Lab in Bengaluru with an investment of Rs 185 crore**, which it says makes it the first service provider to offer integrated silicon design and validation from India.

**Tata Consultancy Services** — wins a **Rs 122.6 crore bid to build the Odisha State Workflow Automation System (OSWAS) 3.0** for the state government, a unified digital workplace for paperless file processing. Immaterial against its own size.

**Ascensive Educare** — wins a **Rs 10,58,26,250 work order from Shabari Adivasi Vitta Va Vikas Mahamandal, Nashik, to train up to 1,700 Scheduled Tribe youth** _(~14.0% of mcap)_, subject to milestones, verification and actual eligible performance.

**Jyoti** — its Switchgear Division secures a **Letter of Intent from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation for a repeat order of 86 11-kV VCB panels worth Rs 663.71 lakh including GST** _(~4.5% of mcap)_, for supply by 7 January 2027.

**Slone Infosystems** — secures an order from **Transline Technologies for 1,000 Lenovo V14 i5 laptops aggregating Rs 6.40 crore including GST** _(~6.4% of mcap)_, Rs 6.28 crore of hardware plus Rs 11.80 lakh of implementation and service charges.

**Suzlon Energy** — wins its **maiden 200 MW order from Ayana Renewable Power**, 64 S144 turbines of 3.15 MW at Limbawas, Madhya Pradesh, on full EPC scope into the MPPCL grid. **No value is stated**, so it cannot rank as a mover.

**Adani Energy Solutions** — its wholly owned **Powerpulse Trading Solutions takes over Adani Power's MSEDCL award for 2,500 MW of Round-the-Clock power for 25 years** and signs the PPA the same day. No consideration is disclosed.

**Adani Power** — **assigns to Powerpulse Trading Solutions the MSEDCL Letter of Award for 2,500 MW of RE Round-the-Clock power** it received on 2 April, to concentrate on baseload thermal, nuclear and international hydro generation.

**NLC India** — wholly owned **NLC India Renewables emerges a successful bidder in SJVN's 600 MW ISTS wind tender with a contracted 200 MW** and has the Letter of Award. Neither tariff nor project value is stated in the filing.

**K.P. Energy** — receives a **Letter of Intent from Emmvee Energy for a 21 MW wind plus 21 MWp solar hybrid project, 42 MW in total, under the group-captive route** for Emmvee's Karnataka factories — its first order in that state. No value stated.

**Innovision** — receives **two NHAI user-fee work orders granted 7 September**, for the Pachwara plaza on NH-39 (Jhansi–Khajuraho) and the IDTL A and IDTL B plazas on NH-3 (Indore–Dewas), both in Madhya Pradesh. Neither states a value.

**Gennex Laboratories** — subsidiary **Deccan Remedies wins Andhra Pradesh Drug Control Administration approval to manufacture six more APIs**, including caffeine, duloxetine and phenylephrine hydrochloride, plus test licences for four others.

**Park Medi World** — incorporates the wholly owned **Park Medicity Prayagraj Limited**, the SPV for the Prayagraj hospital project it disclosed on 31 August. No consideration or subscription figure is given in this filing.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Raymond** — its board approves **33,28,686 convertible warrants at Rs 645 including a Rs 635 premium to Minerva Ventures Fund, up to about Rs 214.71 crore** _(~4.2% of mcap)_, taking the fund from nil to 4.35% fully diluted; members' approval pending.

**Century Extrusions** — fixes the terms of its **Rs 45 crore rights issue: 3,00,00,000 partly paid shares at Rs 15, three for every eight held, record date 15 September, open 23 September to 14 October** _(~26.9% of mcap)_, and files the Letter of Offer.

**Kabra Extrusiontechnik** — clarifies, at the exchanges' request, the promoter/non-promoter status of the **twelve proposed allottees of its Rs 141 crore issue of 37,60,000 shares at Rs 375** _(~6.4% of mcap)_ — among them Singularity Large Value Fund III, Utpal Sheth and Kiran Vyapar.

**KCK Industries** — its board approves **up to 2,50,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 20 each, Rs 50,00,00,000** _(~51.7% of mcap)_, on a preferential basis, subject to a special resolution at the AGM; it also moves both its offices within Chandigarh.

**Shah Foods** — its 7 September board approves **up to 18,90,410 convertible warrants at Rs 153 to the promoter group for cash** and raises authorised capital to Rs 25.50 crore from Rs 24 crore, both subject to shareholder and exchange approval.

**Continental Securities** — intimates a **proposed expansion into gold loans and mutual-fund distribution**. The filing states no capital outlay, no timeline and no funding plan, so there is no raise in it despite the theme it was filed under.
equity_allotments: **GACM Technologies** — approves a **revised allottee list and count for the 1,20,26,34,840 shares of Re 1 to be issued at par to WEXL EDU's shareholders at a 120:1 swap ratio, against an enterprise value of Rs 120.26 crore**, subject to statutory approvals.

**Fonebox Retail** — allots **30,00,000 shares at Rs 85.80, Rs 25,74,00,000, for consideration other than cash** to three sellers, discharging what it owes them for their equity in **NWOM Retailers**; listing and trading approvals to follow.

**Gujjubhai Industries** — its 7 September board approves buying **100% of Café Gujjubhai for Rs 15,90,01,768**, discharged almost wholly by issuing **12,04,915 shares at Rs 131.96** to its sellers, with Rs 1,185 in cash for fractions.

**Z-Tech (India)** — allots **3,95,200 equity shares at Rs 500, including a Rs 490 premium** — the store sizes the issue at Rs 14.82 crore, while the share count and price imply Rs 19.76 crore on our arithmetic; the cached pages stop before the allottee table.

**Interiors & More** — allots **15,54,000 warrants at Rs 179 including a Rs 169 premium, for cash**, to promoter-group and public allottees, completing the issue its board approved on 18 July and its shareholders on 14 August.

**Zinema Media and Entertainment** — approves issuing **24,99,000 shares at par, Rs 2,49,90,000, to the unsecured financial creditors of Premier Futsal Management** in settlement under an NCLT resolution plan, and raises authorised capital to Rs 10 crore.
**Pakka** — receives **trading approvals from BSE and NSE for the 27,20,000 shares already allotted to non-promoters on a preferential basis**, the last process step before those shares can trade.

**Anondita Medicare** — **nullifies the part of its 7 September corrigendum that had revised the rights issue upward**, so the Letter of Offer's original 9,58,000 shares and Rs 91.01 crore issue size stand; the odd-lot change survives.
m_and_a: **Kesar Enterprises** — approves the **slump sale of its Baheri sugar, distillery and cogeneration undertaking to Avadh Foods and Multi Warehouse for Rs 431 crore** _(~431.5% of mcap)_, before deduction of the undertaking's liabilities, on an MoU with the business transfer agreement to follow. The division turned over Rs 304.50 crore with a **negative net worth of Rs 133.24 crore**, and the buyer was incorporated on 6 March 2026.

**Systematic Industries** — approves buying **100% of promoter-group Wire Brigade Industries at Rs 21,500 a share, Rs 21.50 crore**, discharged as 9,42,600 own shares at Rs 228 plus Rs 86,000 cash, inside a wider Rs 33,94,00,800 preferential issue to proposed allottees.

**Globesecure Technologies** — executes an SSA to **subscribe Rs 6.00 crore for 75% of ANA Cyber Forensic** _(~32.2% of mcap)_, plus an SPA for 51% of Optimistic Technology Solutions and an MoU for 51% of Crescent Technologies; payment falls due after its rights issue.

**Bank of Baroda** — proposes to **divest up to 76,90,375 shares, 35% of its holding in the National Stock Exchange of India, by offer for sale through the NSE IPO**, subject to regulatory approvals. No price or proceeds figure is stated.

**HMA Agro Industries** — approves selling its **entire 100% holding in FNS Agro Foods, 8,95,593 shares at Rs 55.92, Rs 5,00,81,560** _(~0.5% of mcap)_ — to individuals of its own promoter group, which makes it a related-party transaction.

**Viyash Scientific** — its step-down Alivira Animal Health has **cleared Italian Golden Power FDI approval for the purchase of 100% of BioForLife Italia**, and now expects to close within two months rather than on the earlier timeline.
**Share India Securities** — receives the **certified NCLT Ahmedabad order approving the amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services into itself**, the step it flagged as pending on 21 August.

**Pitti Engineering** — the **NCLT Hyderabad approves the amalgamation of Pitti Industries and Dakshin Foundry into the company** by order of 8 September; the certified copy is awaited and the scheme runs from its appointed date.

**Venmax Drugs and Pharmaceuticals** — the **NCLT Hyderabad directs it to convene an equity shareholders' meeting on 24 October** on the amalgamation of Hatri Pharma into the company, by order received 7 September.

**Fredun Pharmaceuticals** — **acquires the pet-wellness brand Furlicks from USV and its subsidiary Wellbeing Nutrition**, its entry into oral-strip pet supplements. The press release states no consideration.

**Simca Advertising** — **acquires advertising rights to six static out-of-home sites at Bandra ROB, Mumbai**, taking its portfolio to 222 sites — 80 static and 142 digital. No consideration is disclosed.

**G M Polyplast** — its members approve the **sale of machinery and spare parts to its own wholly owned Regranix for up to Rs 2 crore** by special resolution at the 7 September AGM. Nothing leaves the group.
**Tata Communications** — **Kaleyra Africa (Pty), a non-operating wholly owned indirect subsidiary in South Africa, was dissolved on 4 September** on completing voluntary liquidation with the CIPC.
**CESC** — incorporates two wholly owned subsidiaries, **Purvah Nexgen Energy and RPSG Nexgen Energy**, both on 8 September. Neither has turnover and no subscription amount is disclosed.
**Tega Industries** — subsidiary Tega MC Global Holdings has **incorporated Tega Molycop Management Consultancy L.L.C. in Dubai**. No investment figure is given in the intimation.
**Avanti Feeds** — **Thai Union Feedmill Ecuador S.A.S. was incorporated in Ecuador on 4 September**, continuing the South American venture it first disclosed on 1 April. No capital figure is stated.

**India Glycols** — passes on **material updates from Ennature Bio Pharma and IGL Spirits**, the entities in its scheme of arrangement, as the NSE and BSE observation letters of November 2025 require it to.
**Pelatro** — records a **50,000-share inter-se transfer by gift from a promoter-group member to his son**, 0.47% of capital and without consideration; the aggregate promoter holding is unchanged.

**Synoptics Technologies** — its board outcome contains **no transaction**: an annual report, an AGM for 30 September, a book-closure period, a scrutinizer and internal auditors. It was typed `jv_agreement` off a generic board-meeting subject.

**Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals** — signs an **MoU with the Government of Maharashtra for a 1,200 TPD maize processing unit in Nashik entailing capex of about Rs 500 crore** _(~100% of mcap)_, but says further steps await the state's infrastructure timeline.

**Juniper Green Energy** — wholly owned Juniper Green Stellar **commissions 6.25 MW of wind within its 200 MW firm and dispatchable renewable project**, taking that project to 353.45 MWp and the group to about 2,594 MWp and 500 MWh of storage.

**Race Eco Chain** — subscribes **Rs 4,66,89,500 for 93,379 compulsorily convertible preference shares of material subsidiary Ganesha Recycling Chain**, an intra-group infusion that leaves its stake at 51%.

business_updates: **Results season** — 8 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Alkem Laboratories** — launches **Renocia Exo, which it calls India's first patented Ginsenoside exosome-based hair-growth serum**, combining phyto-exosomes with biomimetic and copper peptides. No revenue or investment figure is given.

**Schaeffler India** — its parent will **consolidate its aftermarket product brands under the Schaeffler name, starting with FAG in a phased global rollout from Q2 2027**, beginning with new packaging. No financial impact is quantified.

**Bandhan Bank** — confirms, on exchange queries after a 4.62% move to Rs 172.10, that the **four new credit cards reported in the press are its own launch**, and that no unpublished price-sensitive information was withheld.

**String Metaverse** — receives a **Dun & Bradstreet 3A1 rating** under a Vantage Plus report dated 7 September, on tangible net worth and a composite risk assessment. It is a credit-opinion assignment, not a business event.

**Master Components** — is **certified to ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 by BSCIC Certifications** for its environment and occupational-health management systems. The baseline filed this under Order wins as "bagging of Certificates".

**Sanofi India** — the **Supreme Court dismisses its petition to quash the CBI's criminal complaint**, ruling only that prosecution of the company is maintainable even with no individual arraigned; no finding of guilt was recorded.

**ICICI Lombard General Insurance** — is in receipt of an **order dated 7 September from the IRDAI**. The company files the regulator's order under Regulation 30 without quantifying a financial impact in the pages disclosed.

**Yes Bank** — an appellate GST order **cuts the Tamil Nadu penalty from Rs 3,01,50,149 to Rs 2,32,68,479** for FY2018–FY2022, a partial win it will appeal further; the bank expects no material impact.

**Lemon Tree Hotels** — material subsidiary **Berggruen Hotels receives a GST DRC-01A intimation from the Bengaluru commercial-taxes audit office** for FY2022-23, ascertaining tax, interest and penalty before any formal demand.

**Sintercom India** — receives a **show-cause notice under section 73(1) of the Maharashtra GST Act** from the state GST department. The amount at issue is in the annexure rather than the pages cached.
**Cyber Media (India)** — discloses an **order passed by the Commercial Taxes Department, Chennai**. The figures sit in the annexure beyond the cached pages, so none is quoted.
**MosChip Technologies** — files a **revised disclosure on the Supreme Court's 1 September order**, incorporating its counsel's clarifications after earlier intimations on 12 May and 2 September.

**EKI Energy Services** — the **NCLT Indore dismisses Oswal Woollen Mills' section 9 insolvency application against the company** by order of 3 September, uploaded 8 September — a favourable outcome, not a fresh distress event.
**Baron Infotech** (under CIRP) — the **NCLT Hyderabad approves its resolution plan** by written order of 8 September, and the company discloses the plan's salient features.

**Hitech Corporation** — updates its **voluntary delisting proposal** with the due-diligence and share-capital audit reports NSE had queried, following its board's approval of 9 June.
**Marathon Nextgen Realty** — files the **scrutinizer's report and voting results of the NCLT-convened meetings of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors** held 7 September on its scheme.
**Vivimed Labs** (under CIRP) — gives **prior intimation of the seventh Committee of Creditors meeting, set for 10 September** by audio-visual means.
**Bloom Dekor** — **withdraws its application to reclassify the existing promoter and promoter group as public shareholders**, so that group remains the promoter of record.

**Inventure Growth & Securities** — the **sole arbitrator rejects the company's and its managing director's challenge to the tribunal's jurisdiction** by order of 3 September, and heard arguments on 5 September; the arbitration proceeds.
